name: Birgitzer Alm
kurzbeschreibung: Discover the Birgitzer Alm in Tirol Nestled in the heart of the Zillertal Alps, the Birgitzer Alm is a true gem of Tirol.
beschreibung: The Birgitzer Alm above Innsbruck is a classic alpine pasture hut known for its panoramic mountain vistas and hearty Tyrolean fare. Hikers, mountain bikers, and ski tourers love stopping here for fresh Kaspressknödel soup, home-baked Kaiserschmarrn, and hearty Brettljausn. The sun terrace offers sweeping views over the Inn Valley and Kalkkögel range, while the rustic parlor warms chilly mountain days with authentic alpine charm.
